name: Gate an agent's code edits on reviewed intents
description: The Lastro plugin for Claude Code and Codex (plugins/lastro) is active in a repository that has .lastro/plugin.json. Its PreToolUse hook treats the first attempt to edit source code, in any mode (plan mode, auto mode, an informal plan or none), as the moment to extract intents: edit tools (Edit, Write, MultiEdit, NotebookEdit, apply_patch) on code outside .lastro/ and outside the configured allow globs are denied, with steps to write the change as prose in .lastro/proposals/<slug>.md, run lastro plan and start the user's review, unless the CLI reports no pending review, spec.json was derived from exactly the current intents and decisions, and the last proof of that spec has not passed yet. Once every proof passes, the next source edit is a new change and is denied the same way. With gate "off" it never blocks. Proposals and handoff answers inside .lastro/ are always allowed; intents.json, spec.json, proof.json, receipt.md, config.json and the plugin's state are denied because only the CLI writes them; edits to .lastro/plugin.json ask the user in Claude Code and are denied in Codex. SessionStart and UserPromptSubmit add the progress board and the rule that the agent is the author of the proposal and never approves it.
